title: A Theory of Relaxation-Based Algebraic Multigrid
summary: Algebraic multigrid (AMG) methods derive their optimal efficiency from the interplay between a relaxation process and a corresponding coarse grid correction. In many standard formulations, relaxation and coarse-graining are analyzed and treated as largely separate of one another. Here we propose an alternative theoretical approach centered entirely on the relaxation process, which exposes its fundamental role in the coarse-graining of the fine-scale problem.
